tickets.title: Create local Kanban UI for ticket management
tickets.description:
## Context
Currently, tickets are managed via JSON files which is not user-friendly. We need a local web UI (like Jira/Trello) to:
- Visualize tickets on a Kanban board
- Drag & drop tickets between columns
- Create/edit tickets with a form
- See agent activity in real-time
- Track ticket history

## Technical Approach
Build a lightweight local web app that:
1. Reads/writes to .forge/backlog/tickets.json
2. Watches .forge/agent-state/ for real-time updates
3. Displays agent status and activity
4. No external dependencies (pure HTML/JS or simple framework)

## Why
Make La Forge more accessible and provide visual feedback on multi-agent workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Kanban board with columns: backlog, todo, in_progress, review, testing, done
Drag & drop to move tickets between columns (updates JSON)
Click ticket to see details and edit
Activity feed showing recent agent actions
